title: OECS Software Definitions
description: Defines the software/firmware capability specification of an EV charger: firmware management, communication protocols and their feature profiles, smart-charging capability, and exposed configuration options.

protocolName.description: Well-known communication protocol/standard names implemented by the charger itself. Use 'other' plus the 'otherName' sibling field for anything not listed. Backend-to-backend protocols the charger doesn't itself speak (e.g. OCPI, OSCP, OpenADR) don't belong here.

protocol.description: A single communication protocol implemented by the charger, with the specific feature profiles/extensions it supports.

otherName.description: Required when name is 'other': the proprietary or unlisted protocol's name.

transport.description: Transport protocol paired with the message/payload format it carries, as 'transport/format' (e.g. 'websocket/json' for OCPP-J, 'tcp/xml' for ISO 15118/DIN 70121's V2GTP, 'tcp/modbus' for Modbus-TCP). 'can' stands alone for raw CAN-bus signaling, which has no separate payload-format layer. Use 'other' plus the sibling 'transportOtherName' field for a combination not listed (e.g. a REST API serialized as protobuf).

transportOtherName.description: Required when transport includes 'other'; the transport/format combination as printed on the datasheet.

securityProfile.description: e.g. OCPP security profile 0-3 ('Unsecured Transport', 'Basic Authentication', 'TLS with Basic Authentication', 'TLS with Client Certificates').

profiles.description: Supported feature profiles/functional blocks for this protocol (e.g. OCPP 1.6 profiles: Core, FirmwareManagement, LocalAuthListManagement, Reservation, SmartCharging, RemoteTrigger).

certifications.description: Formal certifications tied specifically to this protocol/version (e.g. an OCA OCPP conformance certificate, an ISO 15118 security certification). Certifications that apply to the product as a whole rather than one protocol belong in metadata.certificates instead.

configuration.description: Configuration keys/settings surfaced by this specific protocol (e.g. OCPP configuration keys like 'HeartbeatInterval'). Settings that aren't tied to one protocol belong in the top-level software.configuration instead.

features.description: 'local-load-balancing': balancing across connectors/chargers without backend involvement. 'backend-managed-profiles': can accept and enforce charging profiles/schedules pushed by a backend (e.g. OCPP SetChargingProfile). 'v2g'/'v2h': vehicle-to-grid/vehicle-to-home bidirectional power flow.

localInterface.description: A single local integration interface exposed for custom/third-party software, with a link to that interface's own documentation, if published.

documentationUrl.description: Link to this specific interface's API/integration documentation. Omit if undocumented or not publicly published.

integration.description: Interfaces for local administration or integrating custom/third-party software, as distinct from the standardized EV-charging/cloud protocols listed in `protocols` (e.g. a local REST API used for a proprietary integration belongs here even if it happens to speak the same wire format one of those protocols uses).

webUI.description: Whether the charger exposes a local web-based admin/configuration UI, reachable over the local network.

localInterfaces.description: Local integration interfaces exposed for custom software. A charger implementing more than one (e.g. both a REST API and an MQTT broker) typically has separate documentation for each, so the documentation link lives per-interface rather than once for the whole section.

configurationOption.description: A single vendor-exposed configuration key/setting (e.g. an OCPP configuration key, a Modbus register, or a proprietary config option).

key.description: Configuration key/name as exposed by the charger, e.g. 'HeartbeatInterval'.

allowedValues.description: Enumerated allowed values, when dataType is 'enum' or the range is a fixed set.

rebootRequired.description: Whether changing this setting requires a charger reboot to take effect.

software.description: Complete software/firmware capability specification of the charger.

configuration.description: Configuration keys/settings not tied to a specific protocol (e.g. a site-configurable current cap enforced regardless of which protocol is in use). Protocol-specific settings belong on that protocol entry instead (software.protocols[].configuration).

offlineChargingSupported.description: Whether the charger can authorize and run charging sessions without a live backend/CSMS connection (standalone/offline mode).
